text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yo, word going around is that today's
your
birthday. Izzat true?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a huge honor to know that you
are aware
of the day of my birth!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Not so fast! I didn't even say happy
birthday yet!
What're ya jumpin' the gun
for?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, I got some tea brewin'. Get your
stuff 'n'
follow me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wha—tea?! You made tea just for me?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's nothin' I wouldn't do for my
junior! I made
somethin' ridiculously
tasty too, so I hope you're
hungry.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I stewed it with lots of carrot, so it's nice
and
sweet. Even the fox god would love
it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! Eat up as much as ya want!
This is
my specially made, ultimate inari
sush—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! You made cake?! I'm so
happy—a cake
handmade by Inari! Ahh,
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Now hold on just a second!
